open_points.text: _observation: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST copy name, size, source_id, status and reason of a rejected source into a SourcePhotoObservation with no file_ref and no photo_id and read no record for it; for a ready source it MUST call read_placement and then read_mark for the project id and its source_id and return the PUBLISHED member of = models.ScanStatus with the file_ref of the placement and the photo_id of the mark when both exist, the PLACED member with that file_ref and no photo_id when only the placement exists, and the READY member with neither otherwise, letting their DelivererError pass.
open_points.rule: **Член перечисления** note называет его именем рядом с адресом перечисления: `the EXPENSE_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction`.
open_points.question: The rejected and ready input states must become the REJECTED and READY members of = models.ScanStatus, respectively.
